description: This file defines a class RedisRemindersProviderBuilder that implements the IProviderBuilder interface for configuring Redis-based reminder services within Orleans silo hosts. It includes methods to set up Redis connection options based on configuration, supporting both named connections and connection strings.

classes.name: RedisRemindersProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and configures Redis reminder services for Orleans silos, implementing the IProviderBuilder interface.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Redis reminder service within the Orleans silo builder, setting up connection options based on provided configuration section.
